summary: Now backed by the part2 API, not localStorage. One GET /groups on mount; every mutation patches local state from its own response.
reasoning: Throws if mounted without an authenticated user — it's only ever rendered inside App.tsx's RequireAuth, which guarantees that. Do not add a page-level null-check as a substitute; fix it at the router level if that guarantee ever changes. createGroup/joinGroup return Promises that CreateGroupModal/HomePage await (they need the resolved Group to navigate/branch); the other actions (addReview, likeComment, etc.) are Promise<void> and are called fire-and-forget by pages, with a .catch/try-catch added at each call site to surface errors instead of failing silently.
